options.content:
- Use Cases: This dashboard shows the basic Git and Code Review metrics from GitHub.
- Data Source Required: GitHub

targets.rawSql:
select
	count(distinct pr.id) as pull_request_count
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id in (${repo_id})
  and base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
	and pr.author_name in (${developer})

with _prs as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(created_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(created_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    count(distinct id) as pr_count
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE
    base_repo_id in (${repo_id})
  and base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
    and $__timeFilter(created_date)
    and author_name in (${developer})
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and created_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  group by 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  pr_count as "Pull Request Count"
FROM _prs
ORDER BY time

select
  replace(coalesce(nullif(trim(a.full_name), ''), pr.author_name), '-', ' ') as contributor,
  count(distinct pr.id) as merged_pull_request_count
from pull_requests pr
left join accounts a on a.id = pr.author_id
where
  $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  and pr.base_repo_id in (${repo_id})
  and pr.base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
  and pr.status = 'MERGED'
  and pr.author_name in (${developer})
group by 1
having contributor is not null and trim(contributor) != ''
order by 2 desc
limit 20

panels.description: Developer participation in the code reviews

targets.rawSql:
-- PR review contributions: approvals, change requests, and comments per reviewer
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.account_id,
    c.pull_request_id,
    c.status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.account_id, c.pull_request_id
      ORDER BY c.created_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id
  WHERE c.type = 'REVIEW'
    AND $__timeFilter(c.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (${repo_id})
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (
      SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
      WHERE pm.table = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
    )
    AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
)
SELECT
  REPLACE(
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(u.name), ''),
      a.user_name
    ), '-', ' '
  ) AS reviewer,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rk.status = 'APPROVED'          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rk.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rk.status NOT IN ('APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED')
             OR rk.status IS NULL               THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commented
FROM ranked rk
LEFT JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = rk.account_id
LEFT JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = rk.account_id
LEFT JOIN users u          ON u.id = ua.user_id
WHERE rk.rn = 1
GROUP BY 1
HAVING reviewer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(reviewer) != ''
ORDER BY (approved + rejected + commented) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 3.4 Top 20 PR Contributions by Review

targets.rawSql:
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    REPLACE(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(u.name), ''),
        c.author_name
      ), '-', ' '
    ) AS contributor,
    c.sha, c.additions, c.deletions
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc       ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  JOIN repos r                ON r.id = rc.repo_id AND r.deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN accounts a        ON a.id = c.author_id
  LEFT JOIN user_accounts ua  ON ua.account_id = c.author_id
  LEFT JOIN users u           ON u.id = ua.user_id
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND rc.repo_id IN (${repo_id})
    AND rc.repo_id IN (
      SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
      WHERE pm.table = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
    )
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(u.name), ''), c.author_name) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  contributor,
  SUM(additions) AS 'Lines Added',
  SUM(deletions) AS 'Lines Removed'
FROM dedup
GROUP BY contributor
ORDER BY SUM(additions) + SUM(deletions) DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  REPLACE(
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(u.name), ''),
      c.author_name
    ), '-', ' '
  ) AS contributor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS commit_count
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc        ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha AND rc.repo_id IN (${repo_id})
JOIN repos r                 ON r.id = rc.repo_id AND r.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN accounts a         ON a.id = c.author_id
LEFT JOIN user_accounts ua   ON ua.account_id = c.author_id
LEFT JOIN users u            ON u.id = ua.user_id
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
  AND rc.repo_id IN (
    SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
    WHERE pm.table = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY commit_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
select
  count(distinct case when status = 'CLOSED' then id else null end)/count(distinct case when status in ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') then id else null end) as ratio
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id in (${repo_id})
  and base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
	and pr.author_name in (${developer})

targets.rawSql:
-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
with _prs as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(created_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(created_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    count(distinct case when status = 'OPEN' then id else null end) as open,
    count(distinct case when status = 'CLOSED' then id else null end) as closed,
    count(distinct case when status = 'MERGED' then id else null end) as merged
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(created_date)
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and created_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
    and base_repo_id in (${repo_id})
  and base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
    and author_name in (${developer})
  group by 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  open as "PR: Open",
  closed as "PR: Closed without merging",
  merged as "PR: Closed and merged"
FROM _prs
ORDER BY time

-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to DevLake's statuses 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
select
	count(distinct pr.id) as merged_pull_request_count
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id in (${repo_id})
  and base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
	and pr.author_name in (${developer})
	and pr.status = 'CLOSED'

targets.rawSql:
with _workflow_runs as (
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(finished_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(finished_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    count(distinct case when result = 'SUCCESS' then id else null end) as successful_workflow_run_count,
    count(distinct case when result != 'SUCCESS' then id else null end) as failed_workflow_run_count
  FROM cicd_pipelines
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(finished_date)
    and id like "%github%"
    and cicd_scope_id in (${repo_id})
  and cicd_scope_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  successful_workflow_run_count,
  failed_workflow_run_count
FROM _workflow_runs
ORDER BY time

panels.description:
1. Mean Workflow Runs success rate over time.
2. The workflow runs being calculated are filtered by "workflow runs starting time" (time filter at the upper-right corner) and "Jira board" ("Choose Board" filter at the upper-left corner)

targets.rawSql:
WITH _build_success_rate as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(finished_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(finished_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    result,
    id
  FROM
    cicd_pipelines
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(finished_date)
    and id like "%github%"
    and cicd_scope_id in (${repo_id})
  and cicd_scope_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  GROUP BY 
    time, result, id
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%m/%Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  1.0 * sum(case when result = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end)/ count(*) as "Workflow Runs Success Rate"
FROM _build_success_rate
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Number of successful workflow runs / Number of total workflow runs

targets.rawSql:
WITH _builds as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(finished_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(finished_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    avg(duration_sec) as mean_duration_sec
  FROM 
    cicd_pipelines
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(finished_date)
    and id like "%github%"
    and cicd_scope_id in (${repo_id})
  and cicd_scope_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  mean_duration_sec
FROM _builds
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  i.original_status AS status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS issue_count
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN boards b         ON b.id = bi.board_id
JOIN repos r          ON SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.id, ':', -1) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.id, ':', -1)
WHERE
  i.id LIKE 'github:GithubIssue:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND r.id IN (${repo_id})
  AND r.id IN (
    SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
    WHERE pm.table = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
  )
GROUP BY i.original_status
ORDER BY issue_count DESC;
